targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-20 (failure autopsy, V3-EXQ-737a): NON-CONTRIBUTORY as claim evidence (claim_ids empty, diagnostic, brake_exempt) but it carries two findings. (1) The bottleneck at D3 is POLICY LEARNING, not representation: ppo_raw_obs -- the control arm, unaffected by the encoder defect -- reaches 0.567 against a 1.0 floor on an environment where local-view greedy achieves 48.05 from the same view (V3-EXQ-738 anchor) and the oracle reaches 57.2. (2) SUBSTRATE DEFECT: the untrained-world-encoder guard measured 0 of 4 world-encoder and 0 of 61 latent_stack tensors changed after 200 P0 episodes -- the P0/P1 warmup has no optimizer group covering latent_stack, so ppo_ree_latent ran PPO on a FROZEN RANDOM PROJECTION and its 0.217 says nothing about REE's learned representation. Second confirmed strike after V3-EXQ-780; zworld_bc_install_failure_V3-EXQ-780_2026-07-19.md found all six _train_all_on_agent callers exposed (incl. v3_exq_728 and v3_exq_734, each with its own copy). The fix was deferred pending the V3-EXQ-783 adjudication, which is now confirmed and establishes SD-070 as the working route (world-path weight-delta 7 vs the x734 configuration's 0/61, PR retention 0.658), so the build is unblocked.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Adopt the SD-070 world-encoder training path in the x734/737 driver family: the P0/P1 warmup currently has no optimizer group covering latent_stack, so z_world is a frozen random projection
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: The P0/P1 warmup in the _train_all_on_agent driver family trains no part of latent_stack: V3-EXQ-737a's guard measured 0 of 4 world_encoder tensors and 0 of 61 latent_stack tensors changed after 200 P0 episodes. Every experiment on this path that assumes a prediction-trained z_world silently measures a random projection instead, with no error and no warning. The fix is NOT 'enable prescribed P0' -- that is refuted in-corpus by SD-070 (it collapses PR to ~1.06). Per the now-confirmed V3-EXQ-783 adjudication the fix has two parts and SD-070 supplies both: (a) a gradient path reaching latent_stack, and (b) a supervision target that is not action-uninformative. Target: world-path weight-delta > 0 with PR retention ~0.658 and P0/P1 phase separation preserved, matching SD-070's measured behaviour. Scope: all six _train_all_on_agent callers per zworld_bc_install_failure_V3-EXQ-780_2026-07-19.md section 6c, including v3_exq_728_trained_allon_capability_point.py (own copy at :481) and v3_exq_734. Also adopt experiments/_lib/zworld_encoder_guard.py in each driver -- section 6d records that the guard landed as a shared module but had not been called by any driver as of 2026-07-19T21:26Z, which is why this defect ran undetected across a campaign.

learning_extracted: A detection guard is worth nothing until a driver calls it. The guard landed 2026-07-19 as a shared module with no driver adopting it; 737a is the run that adopted it, and that adoption is the only reason a 7.1-hour run is interpretable rather than quietly wrong. Landing a guard and adopting it are separate work items.

Record a confound rather than gating on it when it affects a subset of arms: putting the guard under recorded_preconditions kept the unaffected ppo_raw_obs control readable, where a flat gating entry would have returned whole-run precondition_unmet and buried it.

A failing CONTROL arm can be more informative than the treatment arm: ppo_ree_latent was confounded and says nothing, while ppo_raw_obs failing at 0.567 against a 48.05 greedy anchor on the same view is what localizes the bottleneck to policy learning.

A phase named for training an encoder is not evidence it trains one -- 'P0 world-model warmup' ran 200 episodes and moved zero tensors. Weight-delta instrumentation on a training phase is cheap and should be default, not a diagnostic added after a campaign goes wrong.

A resolved upstream adjudication should be re-checked before repeating 'blocked': the 780 doc's deferral to V3-EXQ-783 was correct when written and stale by the time 737a ran. Deferrals need a re-check trigger or they outlive their cause.

Add a policy-learning positive control (a trained policy known to clear the floor at D3) so representation-quality and policy-learning-capacity can be separated -- without it a null on the REE latent stays aliased with 'PPO cannot learn this at this budget'
